---
description: turn_carried as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: reading what the earlier build recorded of a turn
arguments:
  turn: "The turn, by its id; left out, the turn this call belongs to."
  part: "One part of the old record to read, by the name the first answer gave it; left out, the answer lists the record's parts."
  from: "Where in the part to start reading, in characters: the answer says where to go on when a part is longer than one answer holds."
---
Reads what the earlier build recorded for a turn that was carried over from it: which engine played the reply, why it stood unplayed, where it said something against what its turn decided, and the parts of its record and the texts they name, word for word. Left to name no part, it lists them with their sizes; with a part, it gives the words, a stretch at a time. Nothing is changed.
